title: F7: Rest engine (short/long rest)
description: Durable hit-dice pool + spend procedure; long-rest gates (8h, 1/24h, >=1 HP) + restore orchestration calling F4/F5/F6 reset hooks; exhaustion/food-water interaction note. Members: short-rest, long-rest (IMPL). Depends on F4/F5/F6 hooks. Source: docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-8-execution-boundary-classification.md §4.
acceptance_criteria: ADR 0018 single-class guard runs before Hit Dice/rest derivation; the initial Hit Dice pool may use one die type/count derived from the sole class and must not claim mixed-pool support; short-rest spend and long-rest gates/restoration orchestrate F4/F5/F6 hooks and are durable/tested; multiclass-shaped state fails with MULTICLASS_UNSUPPORTED.
notes:

See docs/active-effect-lifecycle.md §8.
